purpose.zh: 练手臂举过头时肩膀的控制，打开上背和肩膀
purpose.en: Train shoulder control overhead and open up your upper back and shoulders.

text.zh: 前臂贴着墙，双臂从 W 滑到 Y
text.en: Keep your forearms near the wall and slide from a W up to a Y

text.zh: 后脑、后背和屁股贴墙，肋骨往下收。
text.en: Keep your head, back and hips on the wall, with your ribs down.

text.zh: 滑到手肘快伸直，再慢慢滑回 W。
text.en: Slide up until your elbows are almost straight, then slowly back to the W.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back off the wall.
Letting the arms drift forward off the wall.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼时少往上滑，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, slide up less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: purpose 去掉「外旋」「胸椎」术语
常见错误拆成一句一个错误；caution 改「X 时 Y」
flags: 派生顶点 1.1 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 注释写顶点只停 0.5 s；若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
